root_cause: When ownership/lifetime management of the RTMP* was moved to the connection meta-data hash (with an automatic destructor), the pre-existing manual free on the URL-parse-error early-return path was not removed, leaving two independent code paths (the manual free and the meta destructor) that both free the same object.
findings: rtmp_setup_connection() allocates an RTMP handle with RTMP_Alloc() and immediately registers it in the connection's meta hash via Curl_conn_meta_set(conn, CURL_META_RTMP_CONN, r, rtmp_conn_dtor). From this point on, ownership of `r` is effectively transferred to the connection meta store, which will invoke rtmp_conn_dtor() (calling RTMP_Close(r) and RTMP_Free(r)) automatically whenever the connect
